cruxes: Is E015's 0.7574 real on held-out seeds, or a kernel reshuffle? This decides how much margin can be spent on epochs.
What share of the 6.6 s is fixed cost (data transfer, whitening, augmentation, interpolate) versus per-step compute?
Does accuracy depend on pixel count in the 28 px phase or only on the 32 px tail? E011 suggests the 24 px phase is already near the cliff.
